title: From Multimedia File
text: Stream from multimedia file, 10 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Multimedia outputs} sets Type of media Audio; {File name} sets the name of multimedia, {Inherit sample time from file}, {Desired sample time} sets the block sample time, {Number of times to play file} sets the number of times to play multimedia file, {Read range} sets the range of audio samples, {Output end-of-file indicator} sets the end-of-file indicator, {Samples per audio channel}, {Output color format} sets the color format, {Image signal} sets the output port configuration for RGB video One multidimensional, {Audio output data type} and {Video output data type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: File name
params.values: Name of multimedia file speech_dft.mp3 (default) | character vector

params.name: Inherit sample time from file
params.values: Inherit sample time from file on (default) | off

params.name: Desired sample time
params.values: Block sample time 1/30 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Number of times to play file
params.values: Number of times to play multimedia file inf (default) | positive integer

params.name: Read range
params.values: Range of audio samples [1 Inf] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Multimedia outputs
params.values: Type of media Audio only (default) | Video and audio | Video only

params.name: Samples per audio channel
params.values: Samples per audio channel 1024 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output color format
params.values: Color format of video RGB (default) | Intensity | YCbCr 4:2:2

params.name: Image signal
params.values: Output port configuration for RGB video One multidimensional signal (default) | Separate color signals | Simulink image signal

params.name: Audio output data type
params.values: Audio output data type double (default) | single | int16 | uint8

params.name: Video output data type
params.values: Video output data type single (default) | double | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | Inherit from file
